=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- `scripts/label_helpers.sh:147-207` | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` issues DELETE requests for every phase label on each call, even when most labels are not present.
  WHY: All reviewers reported the same root cause; this creates unnecessary API traffic and rate-limit pressure.
- `scripts/label_helpers.sh:147-207` | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The label name encoding only replaces `:` and does not robustly encode other URL-unsafe characters.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed the helper is fragile for labels containing spaces or other reserved characters; severity is the highest reported, with one reviewer disagreeing by omitting it.
- `scripts/label_helpers.sh:160-166` | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Missing required arguments return success instead of an error.
  WHY: This masks caller/configuration bugs by making an invalid invocation look successful.
- `scripts/label_helpers.sh:197-204` | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The function returns success even when applying the target label fails.
  WHY: The source review says POST failures are only warned about and then the function still returns `0`, hiding real label-operation failures.
- `scripts/label_helpers.sh:172-182` | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The DELETE error classification uses a case-sensitive pattern that may miss GitHub error variants.
  WHY: Reviewers identified the regex as too narrow for possible error text casing/format differences.
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2458-2553,2626-2722,3354-3479` | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` is duplicated inline in multiple workflow blocks instead of being centralized.
  WHY: All reviewers reported the same maintenance/drift problem; some also described unreachable dead-guard copies.
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2436-2445` | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: Sourcing `label_helpers.sh` redirects stderr to `/dev/null`, hiding helper syntax and load errors.
  WHY: The reviewers agreed this suppresses visibility into helper load failures; one reviewer considered it intentional and not a blocking issue.
- `.github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:199-207` | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The null check only handles the literal string `"null"`.
  WHY: Reviewers flagged that GitHub Actions may supply empty strings instead, though one reviewer said the pattern is established and acceptable.
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:24461-24509,2663-2722,3408-3479` | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2]
  PROBLEM: The fallback `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` implementations do not fully match the shared helper’s label cleanup behavior.
  WHY: The review says the fallback paths only add the target label without removing other phase labels, risking conflicting state.
- `tests/test_ai_label_precreation_contract.py:50-77` | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The test checks for helper usage but not the helper definition itself.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed this is a coverage gap, though one noted the test’s purpose is workflow contract validation rather than runtime helper verification.
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2462-2498` | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: A later `if ! type set_issue_phase_label_resilient` block is dead code because the function is already defined earlier in the same block.
  WHY: This was called out as unreachable redundancy that adds maintenance noise.
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2476-2566` | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The inline fallback label logic can diverge from the shared label registry and helper behavior.
  WHY: Reviewers said the fallback uses its own local arrays/metadata and can drift from the central definitions, risking inconsistent label state or appearance.
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:24461-24509` | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The fallback `ensure_label_exists` metadata is incomplete for some labels.
  WHY: The review says fallback label descriptions/colors are only specific for some labels, leaving others with generic metadata.
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3411-3479` | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: A fallback path omits the label-cleanup loop before adding the target phase label.
  WHY: The review says this would leave conflicting phase labels behind if the fallback ever executes.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- `scripts/label_helpers.sh:147-207` | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The function issues DELETE requests for every phase label on every call, even when most labels are not present.
  WHY: Each call makes about 10 DELETE requests where typically only one or none would succeed, wasting API quota and increasing latency.
- `scripts/label_helpers.sh:147-207` | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: URL encoding only handles colons and not other URL-unsafe characters.
  WHY: Labels with spaces or other special characters could fail to delete because the GitHub API path would be malformed.
- `scripts/label_helpers.sh:160-166` | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Missing required arguments are treated as success, hiding configuration bugs.
  WHY: Callers cannot detect when they passed invalid arguments, leading to silent failures.
- `scripts/label_helpers.sh:172-182` | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The error regex pattern is case-sensitive in a way that may miss GitHub API error variants.
  WHY: Non-404 DELETE failures could be misclassified as "label not present", leaving inconsistent state.
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2458-2553,2626-2722,3354-3479` | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` is duplicated inline in multiple `run:` blocks instead of being sourced from the shared helper.
  WHY: Bugs fixed in one copy will not automatically fix the others, causing inconsistent behavior across workflow steps.
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2436-2445` | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `source "${SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR}/label_helpers.sh" 2>/dev/null` suppresses all errors including syntax errors.
  WHY: Broken helpers fail silently, forcing the fallback path without operator visibility.
- `.github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:199-207` | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Checks for literal string `"null"` but GitHub Actions might provide empty strings instead.
  WHY: Could skip API refetch when PR title/body are actually empty, missing linked issues.
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:24461-24509, 2663-2722, 3408-3479` | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Fallback implementations only add the target label without removing other phase labels.
  WHY: Issues can end up with multiple conflicting phase labels such as `ai:done` and `ai:review-blocked`.
- `tests/test_ai_label_precreation_contract.py:50-77` | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Test checks for calls to `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` but not that the function is actually defined.
  WHY: The test could pass while runtime fails due to a missing helper definition.
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml (commit_changes step context)` | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `LEDGER_ONLY_COMMIT` may not be properly exported for downstream step consumption.
  WHY: Steps checking `steps.commit_changes.outputs.ledger_only_commit` may get the wrong value.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- `scripts/label_helpers.sh:185-188` | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The function runs a `DELETE` request for every label in `_AI_PHASE_TRANSITION_LABELS` on each invocation.
  WHY: This causes about 10 API calls per update, wasting rate limit budget and slowing workflow execution.
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2462-2498` | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: A later `if ! type set_issue_phase_label_resilient` block is dead code because the function is already defined earlier in the same block.
  WHY: The second block is unreachable and only adds maintenance confusion.
- `scripts/label_helpers.sh:182` | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The label encoding only replaces `:`.
  WHY: Other URL-unsafe characters such as spaces or plus signs would make the DELETE path malformed.
- `scripts/label_helpers.sh:160-166` | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Missing required arguments return success instead of an error.
  WHY: This hides environment or logic errors and makes invalid calls look successful.
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2476-2566` | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The inline fallback logic is duplicated and must be manually kept in sync with the shared helper.
  WHY: Any bug fix in one copy can diverge from the others, increasing maintenance risk.
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2557-2566` | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The first fallback block unconditionally calls `ensure_label_exists`, unlike the other fallback variant.
  WHY: This creates inconsistent fallback behavior if `ensure_label_exists` is unavailable.
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2495-2553` | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The fallback redeclares a local `_phase_labels` array instead of using the central `_AI_PHASE_TRANSITION_LABELS` array.
  WHY: The local list can drift from the shared label registry and become stale.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- `scripts/label_helpers.sh:160-166` | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Missing required arguments return success and hide misconfiguration.
  WHY: Callers cannot distinguish a no-op caused by invalid input from a successful label operation.
- `scripts/label_helpers.sh:197-199` | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The function returns success even when applying the target label fails.
  WHY: The `POST` failure is masked, so callers assume the phase transition succeeded.
- `scripts/label_helpers.sh:177-207` | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The DELETE loop iterates through all phase labels and deletes each one whether or not it exists.
  WHY: This creates unnecessary API calls and slows workflows.
- `scripts/label_helpers.sh:170` | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Only `:` is encoded in the label path.
  WHY: Other URL-unsafe characters would not be handled correctly.
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:24,458-25,53 and 26,26-27,22` | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` function is duplicated inline in multiple run blocks.
  WHY: The repeated copies increase maintenance burden and can drift apart.
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:24,436-24,445` | severity=low
